name: Shortbread Cookies
instructions: Whip butter and gradually add icing sugar
Gradually add cornstarch and mix well
Gradually add flour and continue to mix
Drop spoonfuls (smush batter in fist to make holly shape) on to un-greased cookie sheet

additional_context.source: Leslie (Tori's mom's friend growing up) made these cookies. There are now a Christmas staple in our family!
